title: AI that understands your universe
description: Three modes. Knows your story, characters, timeline, and lore. Never writes for you.
chatDesc: Knows your story in real time. Suggests when you're stuck so you never have writer's block again.
chatUser: What do you think of the end of chapter 3?
chatAi: Elena's arc has good progression, but the revelation feels rushed.
characterAiDesc: Talk to your characters in role. Based on their sheet and context.
characterUser: Why did you make that decision?
characterAi2: "Because you left me no choice. If I didn't, I'd lose everything again..."
suggestionsDesc: Reads as you write. Flags inconsistencies, detects plot holes.
inconsistency: Inconsistency: age changed from ch. 2 to ch. 5
plotHole: Plot hole: how did Elena get to the port?
